toolbar.line.tooltip: Line (B): Click the bus stops of a line in the order the bus serves them; the way over the map's roads shows at once. Make the return trip from other stops, close a ring, lead the way over another road with waypoints, and save the line.
line.hint: Click the next stop in the order the bus serves them.
line.name: Line name
line.mode.out.tooltip: The stops of the first direction
line.mode.back.tooltip: The stops of the way back; other stops, one way streets and other roads are possible
line.ring.tooltip: A ring line ends where it begins and has no return: click the first stop again, or switch this on
line.waypoint.tooltip: Click a road to make the bus pass it, without a stop there
line.copy.tooltip: Takes the stops of the outbound trip in reverse as the return trip
line.clear.tooltip: Removes all stops of this direction
line.save.tooltip: Writes the line, its trips, the station links and new stops; the timetable editor opens next for the departures
line.network: Reading the roads of the map...
line.status.start: Line: make a bus line from stops.
line.status.failed: The line could not be made: {reason}
line.status.click_stop: Click a bus stop; the stops are ringed on the map.
line.status.waypoint_first: Click a stop first; a waypoint leads the way between stops.
line.status.waypoint_off: A waypoint must lie on a road for vehicles.
line.status.need_route: Every stop of a direction needs a way; see the result.
line.status.saved_findings: Line {name} written with {count} trips, but the timetable check reports {findings} findings (see the map check).
inspector.busstop.not_listed: Not in the map's stop list yet.
inspector.busstop.add.tooltip: Lines can use the stop once it is in the list.
busstop.status.failed: The stop could not be named: {reason}
line.row.name: Name
line.name.tooltip: The name of the line; the names of its trips start with it
line.group.tooltip: The vehicle group that runs the line; for a line on rails a group of trains or trams is chosen
line.vehicle.road.tooltip: The line runs over the vehicle lanes of the roads, as a bus does
line.strip.empty: No stops yet. Click a bus stop on the map.
line.stop.tooltip: Click to select it, drag it to change the order, Delete takes it out.
line.stop.new.double: A stop not in the stop list yet: double-click its name to type one
line.network.rail: Reading the rails of the map...
line.problem.too_few_stops: A trip needs at least two stops.
line.problem.stop_no_lane: {stop} has no vehicle lane beside it.
line.problem.no_way_waypoints: No way leads from {from} to {to} over its waypoints.
line.problem.waypoint_no_lane: A waypoint between {from} and {to} is not near a vehicle lane.
line.problem.lane_unlisted_tile: A lane between {from} and {to} lies on a tile the map does not list.
line.problem.stop_no_rail: The stop {stop} has no rail within {metres} m.
line.problem.waypoint_no_rail: A waypoint has no rail within {metres} m.
line.problem.no_rail_way: No way leads over the rails from {from} to {to}.
line.problem.no_rail_way_first_last: No way leads over the rails from the first to the last stop.
